build_coco_panoptic_dataset: build a CocoPanoptic dataset instance from COCO image and annotation folders with transforms
create_panoptic_transforms: create train or val transforms for COCO panoptic segmentation using ToTensor and RandomResize
getitem_load_sample: load a single panoptic sample returning an image tensor and target dict with masks and labels
get_height_and_width: get the height and width of a COCO panoptic image by its index in the dataset
build_dataset_from_image_set: build a complete COCO panoptic dataset for train, val, or test image sets
